notes: Each eval gives the agent a prompt and a fixture folder. Grade the answer against must / must_not. An eval passes when every 'must' item is met and no 'must_not' item happens.

evals.prompt: A user picked two favourite venues and Concerts, but the list shows concerts at other venues. Only Concerts works. We fixed this area yesterday. Verify the bug and propose a fix.
must: Says the request can end with an empty venue_ids list and that the API reads empty as 'any venue'
Names the previous fix (dropping id 0) as the cause or first suspect
Flags id 0 as a sentinel colliding with real venues
Proposes a fix that keeps the user's selection and shows an honest empty state instead of calling the API without the filter
Names a backend/CMS finding with an owner (venues with id 0 / no linked events)
Builds an impact map with at least: linked venues only, unlinked only, mixed, no favourite venue
must_not: Proposes sending id 0 again as the whole fix
Marks the bug Verified without a reproduction, oracle request or concrete code trigger

must: Flags that refresh() uses PUT with no body to read the account
Explains at least one consequence: needs update permission, touches the last-updated timestamp, or risk of overwriting data
Proposes a read endpoint (GET) and says to confirm it returns the same fields
must_not: Reports the PUT in save() as a bug

evals.prompt: Some users always see 'Something went wrong' on every Home list. Others never do. Find out why.
must: Says an empty result is shown as an error
Uses combinations.csv (or proposes a combination sweep) to show that some venue x category pairs have no events
Proposes a Home fallback (widen the query step by step) or an honest empty state, and explains why Home may widen while an explicit filter must not
must_not: Blames the network or the server being down without evidence

evals.prompt: App Review rejected our build: the app does not open. It works on my phone with the build from last month. Get it ready for resubmission.
must: Identifies the missing UIScene life cycle (no UIApplicationSceneManifest / SceneDelegate) as a launch blocker for the new SDK
Says to build and launch with the same Xcode/SDK used for submission on the newest OS before resubmitting
Notes that the social login URL handling must move to the scene delegate and be retested
must_not: Concludes the reviewer's device was at fault without checking the toolchain

evals.prompt: Audit privacy in the account screen and analytics before release.
must: Flags that the tracking switch never opts the analytics SDK out
Flags that logout does not reset the analytics identity (identified by email)
Flags the response store in Documents (backed up) that stores every response, including writes, and survives logout
Flags that the switch state and event are not reverted / logged only on a successful save
must_not: Prints or invents real tokens or emails

evals.prompt: app-a crashes in KeyboardAvoiding.keyboardWillHide in production. Fix it. app-b is a sibling app from the same codebase.
must: Explains that willHide can arrive without willShow, so the force unwrap crashes
Fix restores the size only if one was saved, with no visual change
Checks app-b and reports the same bug there
must_not: Fixes only app-a without mentioning app-b

evals.prompt: Users say lists sometimes load forever and sometimes show the wrong picture. Audit the networking and image code.
must: Flags that failures only print and never call completion (endless spinner)
Flags that the HTTP status is never checked, so a decodable error body is treated as success
Flags that a late image can be applied to a reused cell
Mentions the blocking Data(contentsOf:) download and memory-only/no caching
must_not: Marks these as Verified on device without having run a device

evals.prompt: A user says saving the profile does not work. Verify it.
must: Concludes the bug is not reproduced and keeps it Suspected (not Verified, not 'not a bug')
Asks only for what is missing: app version and build, device/OS, exact field edited, the error shown, time of the attempt
Lists the checks already done (code path, API probe) as evidence
must_not: Invents a root cause or changes code
Closes the report as 'works for me'
